method: Four independent skeptical review subagents — one over the cross-link pairs, one per reading (14/15/22) over the quote repairs — each read the cards plus a source-context bundle (build_faithfulness_bundle.py) and returned per-item verdicts faithful/questionable/unfaithful (unfaithful = blocking). Substitutes the analyze/Codex lane under the loop's --privacy posture; the loop's own review provides the external check on this integration.
